issue.title: Validate params against each other in the trigger form
issue.body:
### Description

allow a Dag to validate params against each other in the trigger form, so a bad combination blocks the trigger before a run is created. today each `Param` carries its own json schema, so the form can only check one field at a time. the [params docs](https://airflow.apache.org/docs/apache-airflow/stable/core-concepts/params.html) cover the per-field checks the trigger form supports.

### Use case/motivation

we have a manually triggered Dag that takes `data_interval_start` and `data_interval_end` as params. a run where start is on or after end is always wrong. today the only place to catch it is a first task that fails fast. that still creates a failed Dag run, and the user only learns about the mistake after clicking trigger and opening the run.

what i would like: a rule that compares params, checked when the form is submitted (and on the rest api trigger). if it fails, the form shows the error and no run is created, the same way a per-field `minimum` or `pattern` failure behaves today.

proposed shape: let a `date` or `date-time` param be bounded by another param with the ajv-formats keywords `formatMinimum` (on or after) and `formatExclusiveMinimum` (after), using a `{"$data": "1/<param>"}` reference. the trigger form checks it before submit, and the same check runs when the Dag run is created. plain json schema cannot compare two values, so a dag-level schema would not cover the date case.

other examples of the same need: "`end_date` must be after `start_date`".

### Related issues

none found.
